title: 賣
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved L235 sentence set. Production D prepares a complete lesson package from latest origin/main. L234:貴 is present in main at branch creation, so no provisional dependency remains for this request.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L234 plus current target 賣
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, protagonist father, protagonist older brother, and protagonist little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
Market vendors or other public adults must be visually distinct from the protagonist mother and recurring teacher.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, price tags, price labels, readable book text, readable coin marks, or readable product marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在市場魚攤前，看著幾條魚，魚販正在賣魚，媽媽覺得魚賣得不貴。魚販是一般市場攤販，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要呈現「魚正在被賣，而且不貴」的情境，但不可有價目表、文字、數字、招牌、品牌或標籤。
主角小女孩和主角媽媽在家裡整理書，桌上有一本舊但完整的書，旁邊有少量硬幣或空錢罐，媽媽像是在說這本舊書可以賣錢。畫面要清楚表現「舊書可以拿去賣換錢」，但書封、書頁、錢罐、硬幣和桌面不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 小馬賣力跑，還是不夠快。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小馬賣力跑還是不夠快
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一匹小馬在草地或安全跑道上很努力地跑，姿勢用力、表情認真，但旁邊可有另一匹馬或跑道前方距離暗示牠還是不夠快。畫面重點是「小馬很賣力跑，但速度還不夠快」。不可有文字、數字、跑道號碼、標籤或招牌。
主角小女孩和主角媽媽在家裡或店裡看一個新書包，小女孩喜歡但主角媽媽溫和地表示新書包太貴，先不買。畫面要清楚呈現「想買新書包，但覺得太貴所以先不買」。書包、錢、桌面和背景不可有文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。
主角媽媽和主角小女孩買完菜後，在家裡桌上或市場攤旁看著手上剩下的一點硬幣，旁邊有買好的菜。畫面要呈現「買菜的錢還剩一點」。硬幣、菜、桌面、袋子不可有文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。

stage4Plan.reason: 「可以賣錢」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。

productionNotes: L234 was already present in origin/main when codex/l235-complete-package was created, so L235 can be prepared as a merge-ready package if full checks pass. Release still owns final integration, ledger/planner updates, and deployment.
